terra.problem: The counter-with-no-destination joke does not make sense as a comparison to the boat crossing.
The passage does not name the town, so it does not establish that the boat did not land at Jericho.
The line about the baker's map being off makes the baker the target of the joke.
The passage does not name the town, so it does not establish that Bethany was not the destination.
“Wrong dock” says the baker's answer is wrong, which the character rules prohibit.
The passage does not mention a door or say strength got the men through it.
The passage does not say the paralytic is in a room.
The passage does not say what everybody expected or establish that no one asked about forgiveness out loud.
The scribes said it to themselves, but the passage does not establish that no words came out of their mouths.
Jesus tells the man to pick up his mat, but Matthew 9:7 does not say that he carries it.
The passage does not say the man does not need a staff or that he carries the mat himself.
The explanation says the man did everything Jesus commanded, including picking up his mat, but the passage only reports that he got up and went home.
Saying he would have hollered along with the crowds places Papa Dorin in a Bible event.
